Gated and merged. Candidate 244257d, gated merged tree 1d843dff, GATE_EXIT=0, 17 suite totals, 1349 tests, 0 errors, 0 failures. Pre-landing recompute moved (bookkeeping only) and a diff restricted to *.scala/*.sbt/project returned zero files, so the gate held -- same narrowing as slice 3.

The fix is the one I asked for and NOT the one I warned against: lemmas are DERIVED from retained raw semantic inputs through Lexical.stems, rather than the existing strings being hand-stemmed. Hand-stemming would have made today's numbers right and left the next hand-written/computed divergence silently waiting.

m1 independently re-derived the affected quantities on a clean detached worktree at the candidate SHA, computing them itself rather than reading the author's report, and confirms the numbers that were m1's own are correct under the fix. That is the right way to accept a correction to your own published figures.
